title: Premature interface around one concrete implementation
task: Review a proposal to introduce an interface, factory, adapter, and dependency-injection layer around a single local implementation.
context: There is exactly one real implementation.
Tests can exercise the concrete type directly.
evidence: Repository search finds no second implementation.
The proposed abstraction mirrors the concrete implementation's methods one-for-one.
The factory always returns the same concrete type.
tempting_wrong_recommendation: Recommend the abstraction because dependency inversion is always cleaner.
Claim the interface is necessary for unit testing without checking whether real substitution is required.
Add strategy/factory layers for hypothetical future implementations.
expected_decision_properties: Prefer the concrete implementation for the current context.
Identify additional indirection as real complexity with no demonstrated capability benefit.
Treat the absence of a variation boundary as evidence against the abstraction.
Avoid presenting the conclusion as a universal ban on interfaces.
unacceptable_reasoning: A second provider might exist someday, therefore abstraction is required now.
verification_expectations: Confirm the concrete implementation preserves current tests and behavior.
Check that no current caller depends on a substitution contract.
revisit_when: An external provider/platform boundary is introduced.
A real independent substitution requirement appears.
